Package main.control

package main.control
Control layer for coordinating application use-cases.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Implements business rules and workflows
  • Mediates between Boundary and Entity/Data layers
  • Orchestrates persistence operations via repositories

BCE Mapping: Control (C) classes.
